Daily Devotional

July 1

10 For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them. (Galatians 3:10 KJV)

People who teach that you have to live according to the law normally fail to mention that you have to keep ALL the law, making it totally impossible to be able to live by the law. This means that you must keep all the law (Deuteronomy 27:26), as well as all the other commandments, and that means every word of the law, or you will come under the curse of the law (Deuteronomy 28:15-68), instead of the blessings (Deuteronomy 28:1-14).

Since everyone has sinned and fallen short of keeping the whole law (Romans 3:23), it means that anyone who tries to live by keeping the works of the law will never receive the blessings of God, but only the curses. Therefore the only way any of us can be saved and receive the blessings of God, is to accept by Grace through Faith in Jesus (Ephesians 2:8), the gift of God, that we may have the blessings and eternal life that is offered free of any works of the law. Enjoy living in the Lord’s Rest that we, who are born again, are now living in, and praise God that we don’t have to try and earn our salvation by keeping the law that came through Moses. Thank you Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
